svg.title: BGZF compression: zipir presets against every peer level
svg.desc: bgzip with libdeflate and with zlib-ng at every level (bgzip -l 1 to 9; with libdeflate, htslib maps them onto libdeflate 1 to 12). Up and to the right is better.
svg.text: BGZF compression: zipir presets against every peer level
bgzip with libdeflate and with zlib-ng at every level (bgzip -l 1 to 9; with libdeflate, htslib maps them onto libdeflate 1 to 12). Up and to the right is better.
Ratio is plaintext bytes / compressed bytes. MB/s is plaintext MB (10^6 bytes) per second of median wall time. Each panel has its own scales.
Peers come from a run of every level; zipir from the report run. Level 0 (stored) is left out, except igzip 0, which compresses.
